notes.title: Disable Platform Option
notes.content:
Some users have reported issues with [i]Game Center[/i] (a Mac based game platform) and Steam. Namely, that if under specific circumstances you attempt to launch PEG, a [i]Game Center[/i] popup will appear and never allow for the game to actually launch.

This is a problem that comes with the integration of Steamworks for the game, which is mostly just for achievements. In other words, for attempting to launch the Steam toolkit, the Mac OS native Game Center also tries to startup, causing this problem.

If you are experiecing this issue, there is now an option to disable Steam entirely (just so you can play the game). While this won't allow the achievements to be unlocked on real time, the ones you completed will still be stored in your save file, so if you want for them to appear on your Steam profile, you just have to re-enable it and launch.

That said, to disable Steam for PEG all you have to do is [b][i]right click the game on your Library > Properties > General > Set Launch Options...[/i][/b]

And enter the following:
-disablePlatform

While minding the capitalization and initial hyphen, which should look like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30632601/4894ceda2938c3f6fa829aec43c5649def512c4c.png[/img]

Once that is done, the game can now launch without Steam functionality (though the Steam overlay will still be there), which should solve the issue. Where again, if you want to get the achievements you collected you'll only have to delete the previously added text and re-launch.

Hope that is of help for some users.

notes.title: PEG Trading Cards
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30632601/084ac2f6b083be5f4e316070ce6438fb5589af90.png[/img]

There have been questions regarding trading cards with the game, namely [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/699600/discussions/0/1484358860945854552/]on this forum post[/url]. This is but a little heads-up attempting to clear up the confusion.

Long story short, [url=http://heisarzola.com/devblog/peg-tc-and-goodies/]trading cards and related goodies have already been made[/url], but due to the abuse of some users, new confidence metrics have been enforced by Valve, and this game has yet to achieve them.

As you might expect, said metrics remain undisclosed, to avoid being easily surpassed by "fake" developers. (People who had a game that sold 100 copies but had tens of thousands of keys distributed) At least, that is the terminology used by Valve themselves. You can read in full detail on their [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/1954971077935370845]official post[/url].

Strickly speaking, a game must reach a certain given of sales, reviews, user activity (play hours, posts, etc.), but then again, the condifence metrics remain secret to avoid being exploited.

Meaning that in the case of this game, modest in sales, but lacking in other metrics such as reviews, cards have yet to be enabled. However, please note that [b][u]the day the green light is given to distribute cards. That same day, all current owners will get them[/u][/b]. So if trading cards are the dealbreaker for you, don't worry, the game WILL have them.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: 5 of the best new Steam releases
notes.content:
Welcome back to Unknown Pleasures. Each week, we wade through the chin-deep river of new Steam releases to find five hidden gems that otherwise would have passed most of us by.

This week: Hadoukens & cherry blossoms, a The Flash game without The Flash, sinister bureaucracy and extremely charming elephants. (more…)
